title: Per-Block Variability Maximization Across All 9 Pipelines
brief: Auto-chain PostProcessor for 4 chip-cutting pipelines, add native per-block optimization to 4 non-cutting pipelines, create universal safety gate for all 8 pipeline outputs. Goal: every G-code block gets physics-optimized variable S/F/power — no more static programs.

formulas: Kienzle: Fc = kc1_1 * ap * fz^(1-mc) — chip-cutting force
Sato: MRR_edm = C * I^a * t_on^b * t_off^c — EDM removal rate
Malkin: u = Ft*vs/(ae*b*vw) — grinding specific energy
Beer-Lambert: I(z) = I0 * exp(-alpha*z) — laser absorption
Schulz: Vc_laser = P/(rho*cp*T*d*kerf) — laser cutting speed
Hashish: h = C * P^a * d_n^b * v^c * m_dot^d — waterjet depth
Zeng-Kim: Ra_wj = C * P^a * v^b * d^c — waterjet roughness
knowledge_sources.tribal_knowledge: TribalKnowledgeEngine (3,700+ tips) — query for EDM spark-out, grinding stone selection, laser kerf, waterjet nozzle wear tips
knowledge_sources.playbook: MachiningPlaybookEngine (296 rules) — anti-patterns for per-pass sequencing, power ramps, pressure cycling
knowledge_sources.registries: MachineRegistry (910 machines — axis limits, spindle specs), MaterialRegistry (6,346 materials — thermal/mechanical props), ToolCatalogEngine (95,608 tools)
knowledge_sources.reference: 20-agent physics scrutiny (complete), 5-agent business scrutiny (complete), pipeline audit (complete), Altintas (2012), Malkin & Guo (2008), Hashish (1989)

phases.title: Tier 1 — Auto-Chain PostProcessor for Chip-Cutting Pipelines
phases.smart_config: ROLE=CNC Programmer + Pipeline Architect | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: After you generate a milling, turning, 5-axis, or mill-turn program, speed and feed for every cut is automatically optimized for your exact machine and material — no extra steps needed. You get one G-code file with all adjustments built in, ready to load and run.

units.title: Auto-chain PostProcessor into PrintToProgramPipeline + add chatter pre-check
units.description: Add PostProcessorPipelineEngine as the final stage of PrintToProgramPipelineEngine. After G-code generation, automatically invoke PostProcessor for per-block S/F optimization. Also add ChatterStabilityLobeEngine.compute() as a pre-generation check — reject ap/RPM combos that fall in the SLD danger zone. Add thermal growth warning when predicted ΔT > 10µm drift.

units.title: Auto-chain PostProcessor into TurningPrintToProgram + add deflection check for boring bars
units.description: Add PostProcessorPipelineEngine as final stage for turning programs. Add BoringBarDeflectionEngine check when tool L/D > 4. Add chatter stability check for turning operations. Wire thermal derating already in engine to use CuttingTemperatureEngine for more accurate prediction.
exit_conditions: Boring bar deflection warning at L/D > 4

units.title: Auto-chain PostProcessor into MultiAxis pipeline + singularity feed reduction
units.description: Add PostProcessorPipelineEngine as final stage for 5-axis programs. Add singularity-aware feed reduction: when A < 15°, reduce feed ≥30%. Query TribalKnowledgeEngine for 5-axis anti-patterns.
abort_criteria: Singularity feed reduction causes >20% cycle time increase
units.rollback: Revert MultiAxisPrintToProgramEngine.ts to pre-edit state; disable PostProcessor auto-chain flag

units.title: Auto-chain PostProcessor into MillTurnSwiss pipeline + Taylor tool life
units.description: Add PostProcessorPipelineEngine as final stage for mill-turn/swiss programs. Add Taylor tool life integration from canonical taylorLife(). Query MachiningPlaybookEngine for mill-turn sequencing rules.
exit_conditions: Taylor tool life from canonical taylorLife()
abort_criteria: Taylor life prediction <1 min for valid inputs

phases.title: Tier 2a — Per-Pass Optimization for EDM + Grinding
phases.smart_config: ROLE=EDM/Grinding Process Engineer + Physicist | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: EDM programs automatically reduce power as they reach final dimensions so you get a smooth finish without restarts or touch-ups. Grinding programs dial back depth-of-cut before burn risk, so your parts are in-spec and you replace wheels less often.

units.title: EDM per-pass discharge energy optimization via Sato MRR model
units.description: Modify EDMProgramAssemblerEngine to compute optimal I_peak and t_on per pass. Roughing passes: maximize MRR (high I_peak, long t_on). Semi-finish: reduce I_peak by 30-50%. Finish: minimum I_peak for target Ra. Use existing Sato MRR model and DiBitonto recast layer model to set per-pass parameters. Output G-code with variable power settings per pass block.
exit_conditions: G-code has variable I_peak/t_on per pass

units.title: Grinding per-pass wheel speed + ae optimization with Malkin burn threshold
units.description: Modify GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine to vary ae (depth of cut) and vw (work speed) per pass. Use Malkin specific energy model to compute burn threshold per material. Roughing: maximize ae up to 80% of burn threshold. Finish: reduce ae for target Rz. Spark-out passes at zero infeed. Output G-code with variable F/ae per pass block.
exit_conditions: G-code has variable ae/F per pass

phases.title: Tier 2b — Per-Segment Optimization for Laser + Waterjet
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Laser/Waterjet Process Engineer + Physicist | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: Laser programs now slow down in corners for clean cuts and ramp power on thick sections — no more edge damage. Waterjet programs automatically adjust speed for taper compensation at corners — no more hand-tweaking.

units.title: Laser per-segment power/speed optimization via Beer-Lambert + Schulz
units.description: Modify LaserProgramAssemblerEngine to vary laser power and feed speed per G-code segment based on geometry. Corners: reduce speed 30-50% for clean cuts. Curves: adjust power for constant kerf width. Thick-to-thin transitions: ramp power proportionally to thickness. Pierce points: high power + dwell. Use existing Beer-Lambert absorption and Schulz cutting speed models.
exit_conditions: G-code has variable P/F per segment
abort_criteria: Pierce dwell causes >5s delay per hole

units.title: Waterjet per-segment pressure/speed optimization via Hashish model
units.description: Enhance WaterjetProgramAssemblerEngine with Hashish depth/speed model and Zeng-Kim roughness model for per-segment optimization. Entry piercing: reduced speed + ramp pressure. Corners: reduce speed for taper compensation. Quality zones: Q1 (rough)→Q5 (finish) map to different speeds. Abrasive flow rate variation for thick vs thin sections.
exit_conditions: G-code has variable F/pressure per segment
Quality level maps to speed correctly

phases.title: Tier 2c — Safety Validation for Non-Cutting Pipelines
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Safety Engineer + CNC Process Specialist | OPUS | HIGH
phases.intent: Every pipeline output — including EDM, Grinding, Laser, Waterjet — passes through safety validation before reaching the machine. No unvalidated G-code leaves the system.

units.title: Add safety validation to EDM pipeline (power limits, gap monitoring, wire tension)
units.description: Add safety checks to EDMProgramAssemblerEngine: max discharge energy per material (prevents workpiece damage), wire tension limits for wire EDM, minimum gap voltage threshold, flushing pressure requirements. Import machine limits from MachineRegistry where available.
abort_criteria: EDM power limits not sourced from registry

units.title: Add safety validation to Grinding pipeline (wheel speed, burn detection, dresser)
units.description: Add safety checks to GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine: max wheel peripheral speed (typically 25-45 m/s depending on bond), burn risk warning when specific energy > threshold, dresser compensation tracking. Import wheel speed limits from specifications.

units.title: Add safety validation to Laser pipeline
units.description: Max power per material from MaterialRegistry (prevents fire/vaporization). Beam delivery pressure check. Assist gas type and pressure validation. BLOCK mode for power > material limit. WARN mode for pressure near boundary.
abort_criteria: Safety check false-positives on >10% of valid programs
Performance regression >2x on laser program generation

units.title: Add safety validation to Waterjet pipeline
units.description: Max pressure rating from MachineRegistry (4000-6000 bar typical). Nozzle wear tracking (warn at 80% of rated hours). Abrasive flow rate limits. BLOCK mode for pressure > pump rating. WARN mode for nozzle near end-of-life.
abort_criteria: Safety check false-positives on >10% of valid programs
Pressure limits not sourced from registry

phases.title: Universal Safety Gate + Integration Tests + Milestone Close
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Systems Architect + Test Engineer | OPUS | HIGH
phases.intent: All 9 program types — milling, turning, EDM, laser, everything — pass through the same safety checklist before you load them. Consistent confidence across your entire shop. You never load an unsafe program by accident.

units.title: Create universal pipeline safety gate hook with tiered BLOCK/WARN
units.description: PostToolUse hook fires after any pipeline G-code generation. TIERED SAFETY: BLOCK for axis overshoot, spindle RPM > max, feed > max, workholding < 1.5x force (hardware crash/injury risk). WARN for chatter probability > 30%, thermal drift > 10µm, coolant pressure margin < 20%, nozzle wear > 80%. Sources limits from MachineRegistry. Calls per-pipeline safety validators (EDM/Grinding/Laser/Waterjet) from U-PV08/09/10a/10b.
abort_criteria: BLOCK mode triggers on safe parameters

units.title: Integration test suite — per-block variability verification across all 9 pipelines
units.description: Write tests verifying variability by PARSING G-code output: extract all S/F/P values per block using regex, compute uniqueValues/totalBlocks ratio. Acceptance: ≥40% of cutting blocks have distinct S or F values. Tests: (1) Chip-cutting: parse S/F from PostProcessor output, verify ratio ≥ 0.40. (2) EDM: parse I_peak/t_on per pass, verify ≥3 distinct power levels. (3) Grinding: parse ae/F per pass, verify burn threshold not exceeded. (4) Laser: parse P/F per segment, verify corner speed < straight speed. (5) Waterjet: parse F per segment, verify Q-level→speed mapping. (6) Safety gate: test BLOCK on intentional violation (RPM > max), test PASS on valid program. (7) Regression: store baseline outputs, compare future runs within ±5%.
abort_criteria: Safety gate test fails on valid program
units.rollback: Delete test file; no engine changes to revert

units.title: Update milestone + CURRENT_POSITION + scorecard
units.description: Mark milestone complete. Update pipeline scorecard: all 9 pipelines should now score 8+/10. Update CURRENT_POSITION.md with new pipeline capabilities.

hook.name: pipeline-safety-gate
hook.scope: Fires after any of 9 pipelines generate G-code. Validates machine axis limits, spindle RPM max, feed rate max, rapid clearance from MachineRegistry.

action.name: validate_pipeline_output
action.description: Invoke safety validation on any G-code program. Returns warnings/errors per block.

skill.description: Re-run per-block physics optimization on existing G-code. Returns optimized program with variable S/F.

variability_metrics.definition: % of G-code blocks with unique S or F value vs total blocks
variability_metrics.baseline_static: Typical static program: 1 S value, 1 F value per operation (variability ≈ 0%)
variability_metrics.target_dynamic: ≥40% of cutting blocks have individually optimized S/F values
variability_metrics.cycle_time_target: 10-30% reduction vs static S/F (measured by PostProcessor time field)
variability_metrics.surface_finish_target: Ra variance ≤ 0.3µm across program (vs ≤ 0.8µm with static)
